## XcodeClient interface

The Xcode client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `xcodeContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [XcodeResources](./xcode_contract.xcoderesources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface XcodeClient extends ClientBrand<XcodeResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[XcodeResources](./xcode_contract.xcoderesources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
